name: System Balance Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the balance within a system processing the transactions.

OPNG.name: Opening
OPNG.definition: Book balance of the account at the beginning of the account servicer's business day. It always equals the closing book balance from the previous business day. |Note: the available balance at the beginning of the account servicer's business day may be different from the closing book balance from the previous business day.

INTM.name: Interim
INTM.definition: Balance calculated in the course of the account servicer's business day, at the time specified, and subject to further changes during the business day. The interim balance is calculated on the basis of booked credit and debit items during the calculation time/period specified.

CLSG.name: Closing
CLSG.definition: Balance of the account at the end of the account servicer's business day. It is the sum of the opening balance at the beginning of the day and all entries booked to the account during the account servicer's business day.

BOOK.name: Book
BOOK.definition: Balance that is registered in the books of the account servicer.

CRRT.name: Current
CRRT.definition: Balance of the account at a precise moment in time.

PDNG.name: Pending
PDNG.definition: Balance of securities pending delivery, such as the orders to sell securities have been executed but settlement of the open transactions has not been confirmed.

LRLD.name: Limit Related
LRLD.definition: Balance of a specific limit value, such as a bilateral balance is calculated in relation to a given bilateral limit.

AVLB.name: Available
AVLB.definition: Balance of money or securities that is at the disposal of the account owner on the date specified.

LTSF.name: Liquidity Transfer
LTSF.definition: Balance composed of the sum of all liquidity transfers made to or from an account.

CRDT.name: Credit
CRDT.definition: Balance representing the sum of all credit entries booked to an account.

EAST.name: Eligible Assets
EAST.definition: Balance representing the potential loan a Central Bank would make in cash if the collateral is pledged, such as securities available and eligible as collateral with the central bank.

PYMT.name: Payment
PYMT.definition: Balance representing the sum of entries as a result of payments processing. Entries relating to fees, interest, or other movements not a result of payments sent or received by the account owner are not included.

BLCK.name: Blocked
BLCK.definition: Balance representing the regulatory reserve that a financial institution must have with the account servicing institution, such as the minimum credit balance a financial institution is to keep with its Central Bank for mandatory reserve purposes. In some countries, a blocked balance is known as a 'reserve' balance.

XPCD.name: Expected
XPCD.definition: Balance, composed of booked entries and pending items known at the time of calculation, which projects the end of day balance if everything is booked on the account and no other entry is posted.

DLOD.name: Daylight Overdraft
DLOD.definition: Balance representing the intra day overdraft granted by the central bank to financial institutions participating in a RTGS system. This balance may vary over time and shall be offset at the end of the day.

XCRD.name: Expected Credit
XCRD.definition: Balance, composed of booked entries and pending items known at the time of calculation, which projects the end of day credit balance if everything books to the account and no other credit entry is posted.

XDBT.name: Expected Debit
XDBT.definition: Balance, composed of booked entries and pending items known at the time of calculation, which projects the end of day debit balance if everything books to the account and no other debit entry is posted.

ADJT.name: Adjustment
ADJT.definition: Average balance to be held in the settlement account at the end of each day in order to fulfil the reserve due.|The approximation will be always made rounding up.

PRAV.name: Progressive Average
PRAV.definition: Average of the daily balances on the account used to fulfil the reserve requirements calculated from the beginning of the maintenance period.

DBIT.name: Debit
DBIT.definition: Balance representing the sum of all debit entries booked to an account.

THRE.name: Threshold
THRE.definition: Balance representing the amount that will be destined for investment. Difference between available balance and threshold for investment limit.

NOTE.name: Noted
NOTE.definition: Balance representing the amount that a financial institution has set aside for a specific reason and which is therefore not available.

FSET.name: Forecast Settlement
FSET.definition: Balance representing the forecast of total of all cash legs for trades that are ready to settle via a central securities depository. Amounts shown are still subject to processing of the securities settlement.

BLOC.name: Blocked Trades
BLOC.definition: Balance representing the projected total of all cash legs for trades settling via a central securities depository that have been matched but blocked in order to not settle. These blocked trades are included in the calculation for settlement (for example to avoid overdrafts).|Usage rule: Blocking can be done by account owner or its counterparties. Usually this is done to chain transactions or to prioritise other trades. Blocked trades have an indicator that prevents the transactions from settling. Once matched, they can settle whenever the freeze is lifted. In this case they will move to FSET. Lifting the freeze can happen anytime during the day and the transaction will be settling in the next settlement cycle which can be the same day if the (international) central securities depository's operates several settlements cycles per day.

OTHB.name: Other Blocked Trades
OTHB.definition: Balance representing the projected total of all cash legs for trades settling via a central securities depository that have been matched but blocked in order to not settle. These blocked transactions are not included in the calculation for settlement.

CUST.name: Custody
CUST.definition: Balance representing the projected total of all asset servicing transactions such as dividends, income corporate actions equivalents, tax returns, etc.

FORC.name: Cash Forecast
FORC.definition: Balance representing the total of all balance types representing transactions to settle, blocked items and custody transactions.

COLC.name: Dividends Collection
COLC.definition: Balance representing the projected total amount of all payment obligations to the participant (bank), based on their role as main paying agent.

FUND.name: Net Funding
FUND.definition: Balance representing the net amount to be funded resulting from all transactions which have an impact on the funding requirement.

PIPO.name: Pay In Pay Out
PIPO.definition: Balance representing the fictive forecast of automated direct debits or payment based on standing arrangements between a central securities depository and the user.||Usage: Pay-Ins and Pay-Outs can be different based on individual payment instructions or available funds.

XCHG.name: Exchange Forecast
XCHG.definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded in exchanges.

CCPS.name: Central Counterparty
CCPS.definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded in exchanges that operate a central counterparty functionality.

TOHB.name: Total On Hold
TOHB.definition: Balance representing the total of the payments that were put on hold because the limits have been exceeded.

COHB.name: Credit On Hold
COHB.definition: Balance representing the total incoming payments that were put on hold because the credit limit has been exceeded.

DOHB.name: Debit On Hold
DOHB.definition: Balance representing the total outgoing payments that were put on hold because the debit limit has been exceeded.

TPBL.name: Total Processed
TPBL.definition: Balance representing the total of the payments that have been processed and are waiting for settlement during the day.

CPBL.name: Credit Processed
CPBL.definition: Balance representing the total incoming payments that have been processed and are waiting for settlement.

DPBL.name: Debit Processed
DPBL.definition: Balance representing the total outgoing payments that have been processed and are waiting for settlement.

FUTB.name: Total Future
FUTB.definition: Balance representing the total of the payments with a processing date in the future.

REJB.name: Total Rejected
REJB.definition: Balance representing the total of the payments that have been rejected.

FCOL.name: Firm Collateralisation
FCOL.definition: Balance representing the forecast of the cash-equivalent resulting from evaluation of existing holdings at central securities depositary that are qualified to serve as collateral.

FCOU.name: Used Amounts Firm Collateralisation
FCOU.definition: Balance representing the cash equivalent resulting from evaluation of existing holdings at CSD that are qualified to serve as collateral and have been used as collateral.

SCOL.name: Self Collateralisation
SCOL.definition: Balance representing the forecast of the cash-equivalent resulting from evaluation of the net incoming balance of securities qualified to serve as collateral for which settlement instructions are held at.

SCOU.name: Used Amounts Self Collateralisation
SCOU.definition: Balance representing the cash-equivalent resulting from evaluation of incoming securities, qualified to serve as collateral and actually used as collateral, which have been settled during the settlement process.

CUSA.name: Custody Actual
CUSA.definition: Balance representing the actual total of all asset servicing transactions such as dividends, income corporate actions equivalents, tax returns, redemptions, etc.

XCHC.name: CCP Guaranteed Forecasting
XCHC.definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions in exchanges, going through CCP functions.

XCHN.name: Non CCP Guaranteed Forecasting
XCHN.definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded in exchanges not going through central counter party (CCP) functions.

DSET.name: Definitive Settled Securities
DSET.definition: Balance representing the cash equivalent of all settled securities transactions.

LACK.name: Lack Of Holdings Transactions
LACK.definition: Balance representing the cash equivalent of transactions with a lack of holdings.

NSET.name: Non Settled Securities
NSET.definition: Balance representing the cash equivalent of all non-settled securities transactions.

OTCC.name: CCP Guaranteed OTC Transactions
OTCC.definition: Balance representing the Forecast of the total of all cash-legs of transactions 'over the counter' (OTC), going through central counter party (CCP) functions.

OTCG.name: Forecast OTC Transactions
OTCG.definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded 'over the counter' (OTC).

OTCN.name: Non CCP Guaranteed OTC Transactions
OTCN.definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded 'over the counter' (OTC) not going through central counter party (CCP) functions.

SAPD.name: SAP Direct Debit Amount
SAPD.definition: Balance represents the settlement account processor direct debit amount.

SAPC.name: SAP Direct Credit Amount
SAPC.definition: Balance represents the settlement account processor direct credit amount.

REPD.name: CMUP Repo Debit
REPD.definition: Balance represents the total of the central moneymarkets unit processor repo debits.

REPC.name: CMUP Repo Credit
REPC.definition: Balance represents the total of the central moneymarkets unit processor repo credits.

BSCD.name: Bulk Settlement CMUP Debit
BSCD.definition: Balance represents the total of the bulk settlement and central moneymarkets unit processor debit.

BSCC.name: Bulk Settlement CMUP Credit
BSCC.definition: Balance represents the total of the bulk settlement and central moneymarkets unit processor credit.

SAPP.name: SAP Queue Amount
SAPP.definition: Balance represents the settlement account processor queue amount.

IRLT.name: Intraday Repo Limit
IRLT.definition: Balance represents the intraday repo limit.

IRDR.name: Intraday Repo Drawings
IRDR.definition: Balance represents the intraday repo drawings.

DWRD.name: Discount Window Repo Drawings
DWRD.definition: Balance represents the discount window repo drawings.

ADWR.name: Available DMV For Discount Window Repo
ADWR.definition: Balance represents the available discounted market value for discount window repo.

AIDR.name: Available DMV For Intraday Repo
AIDR.definition: Balance represents the available discounted market value for intraday repo.
